usedFor: Ploomes holds deals and contacts, and Calendly makes a booking link when “Create Deal” runs “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Deal” in Ploomes, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new deal gets a booking link ready to send, so the first meeting is one click away.

watchOut: “Deal Updated” fires on every edit, so the same deal can make several scheduling links.
